name: NAIF kernels host adapter
description: Host side of the NAIF kernel retrieval flow: plugin.getConfig (keys naif_kernels_enabled, naif_kernels_producer_peer_id, naif_kernels_source), the retrieval receipt, and adding each built kernel file to the node's IPFS through the existing ipfs capability (ipfs.add, pinned). Range planning, DAF cutting and the $PNM records stay in the portable core.

sequentialJustification.detail: One configuration read or one ipfs.add host call per file, serially; the host owns I/O. No threads.

wildcardJustification.detail: Generic timer tick. Configuration is supplied by plugin.getConfig.
